verses.en: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
verses.pt: Deus meu, Deus meu, por que me desamparaste? por que estás afastado de me auxiliar, e das palavras do meu bramido?
verses.en_web: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker on Aijeleth-hash-shahar. A Psalm. Of David.> My God, my God, why are you turned away from me? why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my crying?

verses.en: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.pt: Deus meu, eu clamo de dia, porém tu não me ouves; também de noite, mas não acho sossego.
verses.en_web: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.en_bbe: O my God, I make my cry in the day, and you give no answer; and in the night, and have no rest.

verses.en: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
verses.pt: Contudo tu és santo, entronizado sobre os louvores de Israel.
verses.en_web: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: But you are holy, O you who are seated among the praises of Israel.

verses.en: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
verses.pt: Em ti confiaram nossos pais; confiaram, e tu os livraste.
verses.en_web: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.
verses.en_bbe: Our fathers had faith in you: they had faith and you were their saviour.

verses.en: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
verses.pt: A ti clamaram, e foram salvos; em ti confiaram, e não foram confundidos.
verses.en_web: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.
verses.en_bbe: They sent up their cry to you and were made free: they put their faith in you and were not put to shame.

verses.en: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
verses.pt: Mas eu sou verme, e não homem; opróbrio dos homens e desprezado do povo.
verses.en_web: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
verses.en_bbe: But I am a worm and not a man; cursed by men, and looked down on by the people.

verses.en: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head saying,
verses.pt: Todos os que me vêem zombam de mim, arreganham os beiços e meneiam a cabeça, dizendo:
verses.en_web: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
verses.en_bbe: I am laughed at by all those who see me: pushing out their lips and shaking their heads they say,

verses.en: He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
verses.pt: Confiou no Senhor; que ele o livre; que ele o salve, pois que nele tem prazer.
verses.en_web: “He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
verses.en_bbe: He put his faith in the Lord; let the Lord be his saviour now: let the Lord be his saviour, because he had delight in him.

verses.en: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts.
verses.pt: Mas tu és o que me tiraste da madre; o que me preservaste, estando eu ainda aos seios de minha mãe.
verses.en_web: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.
verses.en_bbe: But it was you who took care of me from the day of my birth: you gave me faith even from my mother's breasts.

verses.en: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother’s belly.
verses.pt: Nos teus braços fui lançado desde a madre; tu és o meu Deus desde o ventre de minha mãe.
verses.en_web: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
verses.en_bbe: I was in your hands even before my birth; you are my God from the time when I was in my mother's body.

verses.en: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
verses.pt: Não te alongues de mim, pois a angústia está perto, e não há quem acuda.
verses.en_web: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
verses.en_bbe: Be not far from me, for trouble is near; there is no one to give help.

verses.en: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
verses.pt: Muitos touros me cercam; fortes touros de Basã me rodeiam.
verses.en_web: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
verses.en_bbe: A great herd of oxen is round me: I am shut in by the strong oxen of Bashan.

verses.en: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
verses.pt: Abrem contra mim sua boca, como um leão que despedaça e que ruge.
verses.en_web: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
verses.en_bbe: I saw their mouths wide open, like lions crying after food.

verses.en: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
verses.pt: Como água me derramei, e todos os meus ossos se desconjuntaram; o meu coração é como cera, derreteu-se no meio das minhas entranhas.
verses.en_web: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax; it is melted within me.
verses.en_bbe: I am flowing away like water, and all my bones are out of place: my heart is like wax, it has become soft in my body.

verses.en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
verses.pt: A minha força secou-se como um caco e a língua se me pega ao paladar; tu me puseste no pó da morte.
verses.en_web: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.
verses.en_bbe: My throat is dry like a broken vessel; my tongue is fixed to the roof of my mouth, and the dust of death is on my lips.

verses.en: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
verses.pt: Pois cães me rodeiam; um ajuntamento de malfeitores me cerca; transpassaram-me as mãos e os pés.
verses.en_web: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
verses.en_bbe: Dogs have come round me: I am shut in by the band of evil-doers; they made wounds in my hands and feet.

verses.en: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
verses.pt: Posso contar todos os meus ossos. Eles me olham e ficam a mirar-me.
verses.en_web: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.
verses.en_bbe: I am able to see all my bones; their looks are fixed on me:

verses.en: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
verses.pt: Repartem entre si as minhas vestes, e sobre a minha túnica lançam sortes.
verses.en_web: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.
verses.en_bbe: They make a division of my robes among them, by the decision of chance they take my clothing.

verses.en: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
verses.pt: Mas tu, Senhor, não te alongues de mim; força minha, apressa-te em socorrer-me.
verses.en_web: But don’t be far off, Yahweh. You are my help: hurry to help me.
verses.en_bbe: Do not be far from me, O Lord: O my strength, come quickly to my help.

verses.en: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
verses.pt: Livra-me da espada, e a minha vida do poder do cão.
verses.en_web: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
verses.en_bbe: Make my soul safe from the sword, my life from the power of the dog.

verses.en: Save me from the lion’s mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
verses.pt: Salva-me da boca do leão, sim, livra-me dos chifres do boi selvagem.
verses.en_web: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, from the horns of the wild oxen, you have answered me.
verses.en_bbe: Be my saviour from the lion's mouth; let me go free from the horns of the cruel oxen.

verses.en: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
verses.pt: Então anunciarei o teu nome aos meus irmãos; louvar-te-ei no meio da congregação.
verses.en_web: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
verses.en_bbe: I will give the knowledge of your name to my brothers: I will give you praise among the people.

verses.en: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
verses.pt: Vós, que temeis ao Senhor, louvai-o; todos vós, filhos de Jacó, glorificai-o; temei-o todos vós, descendência de Israel.
verses.en_web: You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
verses.en_bbe: You who have fear of the Lord, give him praise; all you seed of Jacob, give him glory; go in fear of him, all you seed of Israel.

verses.en: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
verses.pt: Porque não desprezou nem abominou a aflição do aflito, nem dele escondeu o seu rosto; antes, quando ele clamou, o ouviu.
verses.en_web: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
verses.en_bbe: For he has not been unmoved by the pain of him who is troubled; or kept his face covered from him; but he has given an answer to his cry.

verses.en: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
verses.pt: De ti vem o meu louvor na grande congregação; pagarei os meus votos perante os que o temem.
verses.en_web: Of you comes my praise in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
verses.en_bbe: My praise will be of you in the great meeting: I will make my offerings before his worshippers.

verses.en: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
verses.pt: Os mansos comerão e se fartarão; louvarão ao Senhor os que o buscam. Que o vosso coração viva eternamente!
verses.en_web: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
verses.en_bbe: The poor will have a feast of good things: those who make search for the Lord will give him praise: your heart will have life for ever.

verses.en: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
verses.pt: Todos os limites da terra se lembrarão e se converterão ao Senhor, e diante dele adorarão todas as famílias das nações.
verses.en_web: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
verses.en_bbe: All the ends of the earth will keep it in mind and be turned to the Lord: all the families of the nations will give him worship.

verses.en: For the kingdom is the LORD’S: and he is the governor among the nations.
verses.pt: Porque o domínio é do Senhor, e ele reina sobre as nações.
verses.en_web: For the kingdom is Yahweh’s. He is the ruler over the nations.
verses.en_bbe: For the kingdom is the Lord's; he is the ruler among the nations.

verses.en: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
verses.pt: Todos os grandes da terra comerão e adorarão, e todos os que descem ao pó se prostrarão perante ele, os que não podem reter a sua vida.
verses.en_web: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.
verses.en_bbe: All the fat ones of the earth will give him worship; all those who go down to the dust will make themselves low before him, even he who has not enough for the life of his soul.

verses.en: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
verses.pt: A posteridade o servirá; falar-se-á do Senhor à geração vindoura.
verses.en_web: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: A seed will be his servant; the doings of the Lord will be made clear to the generation which comes after.

verses.en: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.
verses.pt: Chegarão e anunciarão a justiça dele; a um povo que há de nascer contarão o que ele fez.
verses.en_web: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
verses.en_bbe: They will come and make his righteousness clear to a people of the future because he has done this.
